job.rawJd:
We are seeking a senior-level Strategic Client Advisor to drive client engagement, business development, and revenue growth within the legal and professional services sectors. This consultative, client-facing role will cultivate relationships with key stakeholders, shape service solutions, and identify opportunities to expand existing accounts while developing new business. The ideal candidate combines strong relationship management skills with a strategic approach to client growth and market development.

Key responsibilities include generating new business through networking, referrals, industry events, and targeted outreach; developing relationships with law firms, corporate legal departments, and other professional services organizations; leading discovery and consultative discussions; partnering with consultants, subject matter experts, operations, and leadership on engagement strategies and proposals; advancing opportunities through the full business development lifecycle; expanding existing accounts through cross-selling; presenting proposals and recommendations to executives; representing the organization at industry events; maintaining pipeline and opportunity data in CRM systems; and supporting the transition from business development to service delivery.

The role also conducts needs assessments, designs customized service approaches, facilitates stakeholder planning, supports engagement implementation, builds strategic account plans, contributes to pricing and competitive positioning, uses market intelligence to find growth opportunities, mentors team members, and helps refine service offerings and go-to-market strategy.

The preferred background is 10 or more years in professional services, including legal services, accounting, consulting, engineering, financial advisory, or another client-driven advisory business. Candidates should have relationships with C-suite executives, managing partners, general counsel, or other senior decision-makers; a record of originating and closing complex opportunities; experience leading client engagements and strategic projects; consultative solution-development skill; business acumen; proposal and pricing experience; executive communication; and the ability to manage several pursuits and engagements at once. Experience in business development, consulting, client advisory, account management, engagement leadership, or practice development within a professional-services environment is preferred. The opportunity is intended for someone who has worked in a revenue-generating, client-facing capacity with ownership of relationships, projects, and business outcomes.

resume.summary: Senior client and account leader with 15 years across agency services, enterprise products, UX, and client-led AI delivery. I turn client needs into clear plans and practical solutions, backed by eight years of direct account-management progression from Account Coordinator to Account Supervisor. I managed Fortune 500 relationships and budgets up to $20M, owned briefs, scopes, client reporting, and strategic recommendations, and coordinated multidisciplinary delivery. Since then, I have grown a team from 2 to 30 and led client work from discovery through a working product decision.
